summary: Revenue of $2.575B was merely in line, but $128M adjusted operating income, $1.51B adjusted EBITDA at 59%, and 1.5 GW of active power materially exceeded the true margin and deployment bars. Quarter-end backlog was only $104B, but more than $25B of early-Q3 commitments effectively validates the ~$129B whisper. The package resolves the central execution concern positively; absent forward guidance and sharply higher debt temper strength and confidence.
